body:
# Description / Content Addidtions

## Additions
This mod adds a new ore, called  the plasma ore, which can be used to create tools, blocks, and (soon) armor.
More content will be added soon (probably), but please know, this is a hobby project, so please dont bully me for not making frequent updates like people did to the developer of muck.
Pictures of recipes and items are in the gallery tab.
